item.title: Taylor Swift, The Beatles, Elvis & More Artists With the Most Weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're talking chart-toppers and record-breakers. Let's dive in.
Drake is still reigning supreme, holding the number one spot on the Billboard 200 with his album "Iceman". This milestone marks his 41st week at number one, extending his lead as the hip-hop artist with the most weeks at the top. He's also the Canadian artist with the most weeks at number one, surpassing Adele's 40 weeks.
What's interesting is that if Drake stays at number one for just one more week, he'll tie with Morgan Wallen, who has logged 42 weeks at the top. And get this - Drake's number one albums span nearly 16 years, from 2010 to 2026.
Let's take a quick look at the bigger picture. The Billboard 200 has been tracking album success since 1956, and some legendary acts have made their mark. Elvis Presley, for example, has had a long and storied career, with his debut album entering the chart back in 1956.
And if you're wondering who else is in the running, acts like the Bee Gees have had their fair share of success, with the Saturday Night Fever soundtrack logging 24 weeks at number one.
That's all for now. Here's a quick rundown of the top acts with 30 or more weeks at number one on the Billboard 200 since 1956. We'll be back next week with more music news and updates.
[Outro music plays]
